main_text.head: CAP. LXX. Priscillianistæ cur sic dicti. Ex quibus erroribus conflati & nati. Erroris autem eorum capita septem enumerantur.
main_text.p: PRiscillianistæ[?] quos in Hispania Priscillianus instituit, maxime Gnosticorum & Manichæorum dogmata permixta sectantur. Quanuis & ex aliis hæresibus in eas sordes tanquam in sententiam quandam horribili confusione confluxerint. Propter occultandas autem contaminationes, & turpitudines suas habent in suis {2}dogmatibus & hæc verba,

p.i: Hi animas dicunt eiusdem naturæ atque substantiæ, cuius est Deus, ad agonem quendam spontaneum in terris exercendum per septem calos, & per quosdam gradatim descendere principatus, & in malignum principem incurrere, à quo mundum hunc factum volunt, atque ab hoc principe per diversa carnis opera seminari. page.notes: The initial "P" is a woodcut drop cap joined to "Riscillianistæ"; the first letter is uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The reference mark "2" before "dogmatibus" has no matching note on this page; it is kept as {2}. "calos" is printed as seen; it may be "cælos". The page is set in roman with italic running text; the marginal note "Maximianus." is treated as a left-margin note.
